https://local12.com/news/local/woman-sen.text: GALLATIN COUNTY, Ky. (WKRC) - A woman was sentenced to 14 years in prison Friday for stabbing a man multiple times in Gallatin County last year. Michelle Anderson pleaded guilty in June in connection with the March 2025 stabbing at an apartment on Third Street in Warsaw. The victim was stabbed multiple times and flown to a hospital by medical helicopter. Anderson received her 14-year prison sentence Friday.

https://english.news.cn/europe/20261026/.text: NATO brigade launches major exercise in eastern Latvia RIGA, Oct. 26 (Xinhua) -- The NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia is staging its largest force deployment exercise from Oct. 26 to 28, the Latvian Defense Ministry has announced. Around 3,000 troops and 1,000 pieces of military equipment will participate in the Resolute Reforger 2026 drills in eastern Latvia. During the exercise, brigade units are set to perform force deployment, supply, command and communication tasks, as well as enhance interoperability with the Latvian army. The exercise aims to test the brigade's ability to move, supply and coordinate units over long distances. Colonel David Brassard, commander of the NATO Multinational Brigade, said the exercise would provide an opportunity for the brigade to demonstrate its ability to deploy combat-ready forces over long distances, sustain them in the field, and maintain effective command, control and communications throughout the exercise. ■ News In-depth Sports Business Culture World China Regions Asia & Pacific Europe Middle East North America South America Africa Organizations Services Weather Live & Work in China Doing Business Investment Visit China Study in China More Special Reports Photos Video Corrections About Us Contact Us Media Qiushi Journal Taiwan.cn Youth.cn GMW.cn CE.cn Ecns.cn China Daily CRI.cn China.org.cn People's Daily
